prompt:
Image 1 is the character sheet for Maya, image 2 is the character sheet for Ryan. Keep their faces, hair, outfits and signature details exactly as in the sheets (Maya: beauty mark above the left corner of her upper lip, small gold hoops, gray cardigan; Ryan: lopsided half-smile, large silver watch on his left wrist, navy quarter-zip).
A 2x2 grid storyboard in a single image, four sequential moments of the same continuous shot, read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Thin white gutters between panels. No text, no captions, no panel numbers.
Setting (same in all four panels): a suburban American dining room at night, long wooden table with a white tablecloth, lit candles, warm amber light, dark window in the background. Maya and Ryan sit side by side in the foreground; Linda and Jess are soft and out of focus in the background at the table.
Characters: Maya, a 34-year-old Latina woman with warm light-brown skin, shoulder-length wavy dark-brown hair tied in a messy low bun with loose strands, hazel eyes with faint dark circles, a small beauty mark above the left corner of her upper lip, small gold hoop earrings, wearing an oversized heather-gray cardigan over a plain white t-shirt and dark jeans, slightly hunched posture. Ryan, a 36-year-old white American man, short dark-blond hair with a neat side part, light stubble, gray-blue eyes, a smug lopsided half-smile, a large silver wristwatch on his left wrist, wearing a navy quarter-zip sweater over a white collared shirt and khaki chinos, athletic build. Background, out of focus: Jess, a 33-year-old white woman with fair freckled skin, long wavy copper-auburn hair, green eyes, pearl stud earrings, a wide friendly smile, wearing a blush-pink boat-neck knit sweater and a cream midi skirt. Linda, a 64-year-old white woman with a short silver bob, rosy cheeks, wearing a floral blouse with a small brooch.
Panel 1: medium two-shot, Ryan slides his phone across the tablecloth until it stops in front of Maya, smug half-smile; the phone screen is dark, face down or only a soft glow, no readable interface.
Panel 2: close-up of Maya's hand frozen just above the phone, not touching it, candlelight on her fingers.
Panel 3: Ryan turns toward the table, arms open wide, talking to the others with a grin; Maya in the foreground out of focus.
Panel 4: close-up of Maya, eyes glassy with tears, forced smile; behind her Ryan and the table laughing, softly blurred.
3D animated feature film style, cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, consistent characters, outfits and lighting across panels, vertical 9:16 framing inside each panel.
